tips_en: Start with the T1 paper on terminal-agent RL—it delivers the most striking practical result (matching Gemini-3.1-Pro with only 10B active parameters) and the TITO+R3 recipe for training-inference consistency is broadly reusable. NCP-ArchPreview is the natural second read, as both it and T1 tackle scaling efficiency from complementary angles: NCP halves training tokens via concept-level prediction, while T1 stabilizes long-horizon sparse-MoE RL. SenseNova-U1.5 is a useful third read, sharing the unified-architecture theme with NCP (multimodal vs. concept-token unification) but with more incremental novelty.
tips_zh: 建议先读 T1（终端智能体 RL）这篇——它在仅 10B 激活参数下就追平 Gemini-3.1-Pro，实战结果最亮眼，且 TITO+R3 的训练-推理一致性方案可复用性极强。其次推荐 NCP-ArchPreview，它与 T1 从不同角度切入训练效率：NCP 通过概念级预测把训练 token 砍掉近一半，T1 则稳定长时程稀疏 MoE 的 RL 训练。SenseNova-U1.5 适合放在第三篇读，它与 NCP 都聚焦“统一架构”主题（多模态统一 vs. 概念-词元统一），但创新性相对渐进。
